children.text: Track sizes across the row. repeat(N, size) expands to N tracks of that size.
120px 2fr 0.5fr auto. The px track is fixed, auto takes its content, and what is left is split between the two fr tracks by factor.
Four columns, three rows. Items take a start line, a span, or both.
gap sets both axes; the longhands set one each and leave the other alone.
flexible tracks and their items' minimums
Three 1fr tracks in a 300px grid. A bare Nfr is minmax(auto, Nfr), so a track never shrinks below its item's minimum: the first two hold their tracks open and the third takes what is left.
an item that clips does not hold its track open
